Hotel networks often block VPN traffic until you accept their captive portal. Here's what to try:

1. Open a regular browser and try to visit any website. The hotel's login or terms page should appear.
2. Accept the terms or sign in with your room details.
3. Once the internet works normally, start the VPN client again.

If it still says the portal is unreachable after that, reply with what you see and we'll look further.

Source: vpn-troubleshooting

Your MacBook Pro (DEV-0005) currently shows as compliant in our system. It has no open issues and last checked in on 2026-11-11. The "not compliant" message and the Drive problem may be left over from an earlier state that hasn't refreshed.

Jamf marks a Mac non-compliant, and blocks Drive and VPN, when one of these is true:
- FileVault is off.
- macOS is more than one major version behind.
- The Mac hasn't checked in for 14 days.

1. Check that FileVault is on in System Settings > Privacy & Security.
2. Check that macOS is up to date.
3. If the Mac still says it's not compliant, re-enroll it. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Profiles and remove any old Larkspur profile. Then go to enroll.example.test in Safari and sign in. Finally, install the downloaded profile from System Settings.
4. Once the Mac has checked in again, sign out of Drive and back in.

If Drive still doesn't work after that, reply with the exact error message and I'll pass it to the IT team.

Source: jamf-enrollment
